finalCombined.scope: Actual immutable packaged Linux software renderer, portrait 720x1280 DPR1, recorded 1920x1080 source resampled into 1280x720 at requested 30 Hz synthetic camera transport, actual local face/body workers and AR, local TalkingHead PCM playback with output-waveform animation. Gesture recognition disabled. No microphone/cloud/real music, physical camera/TV/display FPS, Windows or wattage proof. Process-tree CPU; summed RSS can double-count shared memory. Idle sleep deadline accelerated from 180 s to 1.5 s for cleanup assertions. Concurrent development monitors share host; phases are indicative, not a controlled hardware benchmark.

failedTrials.resolution: Saved resume/suspend stack trace identifies TalkingHead.showAvatar/start issuing the startup resume. Suppress that unused initialization start, activate only after owned stream setup, and stop hidden animation on shutdown. Final exact archive passes.

limits: Recorded-video decoding, canvas resampling and capture transport contribute to measured process CPU.
Injected heartbeat/RAF and CDP sampling also contribute, including during sleep. Zero scene/avatar submissions is tested; measured whole-process CPU is not zero.
Shared host with independent prior-build monitors; no controlled before/after CPU saving claim.
No microphone/cloud/live music/watch workload, physical camera/TV/Windows, physical display FPS, wattage or full goal completion proof.
